entities.summary: Caerphilly is a town and community in Wales. It is situated at the southern end of the Rhymney Valley and separated from the Cardiff suburbs of Lisvane and Rhiwbina by Caerphilly Mountain. Caerphilly is a town in Northern Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
